📢 Opportunity | FAU President's Internship Program for Community Impact (PIPCI) — Spring 2027

FAU's Career Center just opened applications for Spring 2027. This is a paid, part-time internship program placing students at 50+ local nonprofits and government organizations. 100 spots total across all majors.

The details:
- $20/hour, up to 20 hrs/week
- January 11 – May 5, 2027
- In-person, local organizations

You're eligible if you:
- Are a junior or senior with 60+ credit hours
- Are actively enrolled and degree-seeking Spring 2027
- Do NOT graduate before May 2027
- Are in good academic standing
- Note: master's students and students who already hold a bachelor's degree are NOT eligible

How to apply (deadline: October 5):
1. Submit your resume via Handshake: https://fau.joinhandshake.com/edu/jobs/11284106
2. Complete the application form and rank your top 5 internships

Info sessions (virtual):
- Sept 16 | 11 AM – 12 PM
- Sept 17 | 12 – 1 PM

More info: https://www.fau.edu/career/presidential-internship-initiative/
